column2: Our ancestors, the $$大天使$$s with black $$羽$$...
are said to have lived beneath this land...
The underground $$世界$$—with spouting magma, $$血$$-freezing cold, and parched deserts all jumbled together—
was a stark $$世界$$ ruled by $$弱肉強食$$, where weaker life was inevitably wiped out!!
They say people could survive there only by giving their all, every day.
People who admire great strength and unbreakable fighting spirit call it a blessed paradise, but...
to me, a place like that...
Anyway, our ancestors who lived in that paradise...
guided by the $$救世主$$, $$メフィスト・フェレス$$...
invaded this surface, where $$大邪神$$ and demons ran rampant, and destroyed the $$大邪神$$ army...
They sealed them deep beneath this continent...
with that $$神の鎖$$, or so we were taught...
